preprocess_images_segmentation_maps: preprocess images and optional segmentation maps for SAM2 model input with resizing normalization and padding
generate_crop_boxes_for_image: generate crop boxes with sampling points for multi-scale mask prediction on a single image
filter_predicted_masks: filter predicted masks by IoU score stability score threshold and crop edge proximity
post_process_masks_to_original_size: post process predicted masks by removing padding and upsampling to original image dimensions
post_process_masks_with_nms: post process mask predictions with non-maximum suppression to remove overlapping detections
